calculation.description: Fade each instrument's three-day return relative to the cross-asset median, activated and scaled only when the fraction of assets with negative five-day returns exceeds 50%. Cross-sectional standardization is applied before stress scaling.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (+0.016260), 2023-2024 (+0.043704), and 2025-2027 (+0.052463). Signal is active only on 393 stressed observations; low unconditional coverage reflects conditional activation. Five-day result is based on only 9 valid dates and is not used for admission.
